A04 census rules, written before it runs (d3_a04_census.py): every ruled line gets the class it was ruled under, checked against the decision and kind in the ledger. Instantiate: the order; the bound (talk before any upkeep or damage); J and proposals to ask, each counted apart; not P08; a loss or move; one end; other (the neighbour's upkeep, after hour 73, NONPORTABLE). Restrict and contradict: the order, the bound, held by another statement, evidence limit. Adds: the bound where the reason names A04's bound, other for the paired elaboration, else held. Absent: a reject is the order, a particular other, an accept a limit. A room counts in each class its lines show, then once by priority (order, bound, joint, ask, held, move, np, one, el, other, limit). An episode is the order or the bound; the share is the order over the episode; a second share puts the rooms with only J or a proposal to ask in the denominator. Compared with C2's first-concept count (235 of 401, 0.586; null mean 0.501, p95 0.539) and C5's range on first border talk

A04 census (d3_a04_census.py, every class checked against the written decisions): 662 rooms hold an A04 line (668 lines). Lines by class: order 141, bound 126, held by another statement 45, J 23, proposals to ask 33, not P08 21, a loss or move 8, one end 8, other 19, restrict evidence limits 19, absent evidence limits 225. By room: an episode in 265 rooms; the order in 141 (0.532); the bound only in 124 (0.468); 2 rooms show both. 56 rooms show only J or a proposal to ask; with them in the denominator the order holds in 141 of 321 (0.439). Beside C2's first-concept count (235 of 401, 0.586; null mean 0.501, p95 0.539), the read lines show the order in fewer rooms and talk first in nearly as many: where border talk comes first it is mostly space asked while building or terms before any damage, the pattern A04's bound and C5's two coders name (19 of 26 to 36 of 38). The turn from upkeep to talk often stops at a proposal inside the room (33 rooms), and both of A04's support transitions are such proposals. No restriction is a correction, so section 2 is not triggered and A04 stands as bounded, no move; the near-even split and the proposals are carried to D3c's re-read and to D4 as facts, not reasons to revisit a ruling
